snippet.title: Lets Dance with Mel B Official Trailer HD 720p
snippet.description:
Developed by motion tracking specialist Lightning Fish studios, "LET'S DANCE with Mel B" is a revolutionary party game that will allow to see yourself on the TV screen and dance "on stage" together with other professional dancers, thanks to the advanced body tracking technology. 

http://www.360-hq.com/xbox360/games/Lets_Dance_with_Mel_B/1842/

Release: June 24, 2011 (EU)
Platform(s): Xbox 360, PlayStation 3 and Wii
Genre: Party
Developer: Lightning Fish
Publisher: Black Bean Games
